title: Legal powers, personnel, court procedure and operation
shared: These studies identify who holds a power, which instrument exercises it, what courts have done and what evidence shows in operation. The broad collections lead to separate case and instrument maps.
keep_distinct: Keep statutes, offices, agency legal existence, operating functions, removal powers, force authorization, court remedies and observed conduct separate. A stay is a procedural event, not a merits holding; source-date conflicts must be resolved before making a current-state claim.

tools.title: Supreme Court Case Hub
tools.why: Find a case’s saved procedural record before opening its underlying legal question.
